page.overview:
Who is Ikkaku Umino?

When Kohari was injured while protecting him during the Nine-Tailed Demon Fox's Attack, he offered to look after her. Ikkaku said he would look after her since it was the parent's job to protect their child, not the other way around. He instructed Iruka to flee. Iruka did not listen, forcing other Konoha ninja to drag him away from the battle. His parents were killed by the Nine-Tails. Their names had been added to Konoha's Memorial Stone when they died.

He seemed to be a very stern, but loving man seen from his refusal to let his son stay on the battlefield during the Nine-Tails' attack while readily defending his family and village. He was a man of few words, but a veteran respected by his comrades.

Ikkaku had brown hair which he tied back into a ponytail, dark eyes and a thin moustache. He wore the standard attire of the Konoha-nin inclusive of forehead protector and flak jacket under which he wore mesh armour that showed past his sleeves. He also carried a large scroll on his lower back.
